decision: Deploy caption provenance with the exact original review prompt. Keep scope prompt as evaluation-only candidate.
reason: Captions fix the observed setting error with modest cost. Scope prompt fixes some cases but introduces repeated mask-setting false rejections; no overall false-rejection improvement.
limitations: Targeted previously seen development cases, not a new holdout or end-to-end accuracy evaluation.
Expected labels are implementation-assistant annotations, not independent human judgments.
Three repeats per case are too few to establish stable ranking of close aggregate results.
B initialization scope error and alpha naming false rejections remain known issues in deployed prompt.
